answer: Georgia has a population of approximately 10.8-10.9 million (as of 2024 estimates). This refers to the U.S. state of Georgia, which is the most common interpretation when the question is asked without qualification. Georgia had a 2020 Census population of 10,711,908, and has continued to grow since then. If you meant the country of Georgia (located in the Caucasus region), its population is approximately 3.7-3.8 million.
sources: Training data through Feb 2025; 2020 US Census
notes: Addressed both referents; noted the ambiguity.
